author: ARLogic LLC
description: fixRAgent maintenance triage for property managers. Three tools, the same as the remote server at https://fixragent.com/mcp: try_sample, assess_property_photo, get_triage_profile. This one-file stdio server lists them offline and forwards each call there. No key needed to start.
name: fixRAgent maintenance triage

tools.name: try_sample
tools.title: Try a sample assessment (no key needed)
tools.description: Returns a stored fixRAgent assessment of a sample photo from fixRAgent's test set (an HVAC air handler and furnace), labelled SAMPLE, plus how to get a free key. Needs no key and no input, reads no photo and spends nothing. The result is a sample, not an assessment of anyone's own photo.

sample.description: Always true: this is a stored example, not a read of any photo you sent.

label.description: One sentence saying what this is.

photo.description: What the sample photo shows, in words. The photo itself is not served.

captured_utc.description: When the real engine produced this answer.

core.description: The fixed contract, exactly as the engine returned it for the sample photo.

next_step.description: How to get a free key and assess your own photo.

annotations.title: Try a sample assessment (no key needed)

tools.name: assess_property_photo
tools.title: Assess a property maintenance photo
tools.description: Assesses a photo of something in a building — an appliance, a boiler, a pipe, a water heater, an electrical panel, a fitting, a leak, damage — and reports what it is, how urgent it is and which trade it needs. Returns the fixed contract: what the asset is, whether a fault is visible, one of four urgency words (EMERGENCY, TODAY, THIS WEEK, WHENEVER), which trade to call, a line to say to the resident, and how many independent reads agreed. One call reads the photo on fixragent.com and spends one request from the key's daily allowance. Sent with NO key, it reads the real photo up to 3 times per connection in a rolling 24 hours (a small free allowance, shared across every keyless caller up to a daily ceiling); past either limit it returns fixRAgent's stored sample result, labelled SAMPLE, and says how to get a free key with no such limit. It reads only a real photo: a written description is not a photo and is not assessed. With no photo, or a photo it cannot read, nothing is assessed and the reply gives a fixragent.com link where the person adds the photo and sees the full Triage Profile. An urgency, trade or finding that this call did not return is not fixRAgent's. Scope: photos of building assets and faults. It does not assess people, pets, injuries, rashes, medical or veterinary questions, vehicles, food, documents, screenshots or photos of screens. It is not an emergency service: a fire, a gas smell or hissing gas, a carbon-monoxide alarm sounding, water pouring onto live electrics or anyone hurt needs the local emergency number (911 in the US), not a photo assessment. It does not price repairs, book contractors or decide insurance claims; it routes the job, it does not quote or dispatch it.

image_base64.description: The photo, base64-encoded. A data:image/jpeg;base64, prefix is accepted and stripped. JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 3 MB once decoded, at least 1 KB. Location metadata is removed on our server before the photo is hashed, read or stored; it is NOT removed before it leaves the caller. Give either image_base64 (with mime_type) or image, not both. A full photo written out as base64 by the assistant itself is long and slow to send, and a copy shrunk or turned black and white reads worse than the original; a call with no photo instead returns a link where the person adds the original photo, and that result reads back by its code.

image.description: The photo as a file reference: an object whose download_url is an https URL of a JPEG, PNG or WebP image (at most 3 MB, at least 1 KB). fixragent.com downloads it once, under the same limits and the same location-metadata removal as image_base64. Give either image or image_base64, not both.

download_url.description: An https URL the photo can be downloaded from.

file_id.description: The host's id for the file. Not used to fetch it.

mime_type.description: Optional. If given, it must match the downloaded bytes.
The photo's type: needed with image_base64, optional with image. Must match the bytes; a mismatch is refused, not guessed.

problem_text.description: What the person reported, in their own words ("no hot water since Tuesday"). Optional. Treated as a reported symptom to be checked against the photo, never as ground truth: the reply says whether the report and the photo agree. Sent without a photo, it is not assessed.

reporter.description: Who took the photo. Changes how the explanation is worded, not the verdict.

depth.description: fast reads the photo three times, deep five, and the reply reports how many agreed. deep is slower and spends more of the day's budget.

image_path.description: Local to this stdio server, not a field of the remote tool: a path to the photo inside the folder named by FIXRAGENT_IMAGE_DIR (off when that is not set). The file is read here and sent as image_base64 with its mime_type. JPEG, PNG or WebP, 1 KB to 3 MB. Give image_path, image_base64 or image, only one.

diagnosis_id.description: Server-minted id for this assessment; the key for the profile and the outcome.

share_url.description: The Triage Profile as a page a resident or contractor can open.

outcome_url.description: Two taps to tell us what actually fixed it.

config_id.description: An id beginning "fallback-" means a hardcoded config answered, not a measured one.

core.description: The fixed contract: asset, fault, tier, trade_required, resident_explanation and the rest.

agreement.description: n reads ran, k agreed. k is null on a tie.

sample.description: true = no key was sent: this is the stored SAMPLE, NOT an assessment of the photo you sent. Absent on a real assessment.

not_assessed.description: true = nothing was assessed; there is no fixRAgent urgency, trade or finding. Pass add_photo_url on.

add_photo_url.description: fixragent.com page where the person adds the photo and sees the full Triage Profile.

handoff_id.description: h-<code>: get_triage_profile reads the result back once the photo is added there.

problem_text.description: On a not-assessed reply: the words the caller sent, handed back so a photo added in the card goes with them.

instruction.description: What to do with a not-assessed reply, and that nothing in it is fixRAgent's.

tools.name: get_triage_profile
tools.title: Read back a saved triage profile
tools.description: Returns a saved fixRAgent assessment by its diagnosis_id (from an assessment, the last part of a fixragent.com/c/<id> link, or the h- code that comes with a fixragent.com photo link once the photo has been added there; with no photo added yet, it reports that there is no result). Read only: it never re-reads the photo, never calls the model and spends nothing from the daily allowance. It takes one id and returns one assessment with no contact details of any kind, the same assessment anyone with its fixragent.com/c/ link can open. It needs no key; if a key is sent, it must be a valid one. Reads are limited to 20 an hour per address, shared with assessments.

diagnosis_id.description: The UUID of a saved assessment, the last path segment of a fixragent.com/c/<id> link, or h- followed by the code from a fixragent.com photo link.

not_assessed.description: true = nothing was assessed; there is no fixRAgent urgency, trade or finding. Pass add_photo_url on.

add_photo_url.description: fixragent.com page where the person adds the photo and sees the full Triage Profile.
